gate.reason: SUM REFUSED across Cover cap.kalshi, Cover cap.pm ×2, Cover sub.usd ×17, Curve sub.usd ×13, Events cap.kalshi ×21, Events cap.oth ×5, Events cap.pm ×30, Events cap.rh ×5, Events sub.usd ×36, Price cap.hl ×6, Price cap.pm ×4, Price sub.usd ×42, Yield cap.hl, Yield sub.usd ×32: window differs (Events cap.kalshi ×21 = P1Y annualised from P30D; Events cap.rh ×5 = P1Y annualised from P91D; Cover cap.kalshi, Cover cap.pm ×2, Cover sub.usd ×17, Curve sub.usd ×13, Events cap.oth ×5, Events cap.pm ×30, Events sub.usd ×36, Price cap.hl ×6, Price cap.pm ×4, Price sub.usd ×42, Yield cap.hl, Yield sub.usd ×32 = P1Y, observation window undeclared). These are different quantities. Declare a conversion in conversions/registry.json — the component, both sides, the rate, its source, an owner and a test — or state them separately.

Cover.cap: zero as placed, not observed: each tracked venue's measured spend is placed in full — Kalshi, Polymarket and Robinhood on Events, Hyperliquid on Price — and reconciles to its measured total (NOT-193); the three venue figures on this board are authored with its frozen grid. A cell carrying no venue figure holds none of the measured spend

hl.why: Hyperliquid's measured spend — core perps, HIP-3 builder DEXs and spot — is placed on Price; none of it is cover

rh.why: Robinhood is tracked as an event-contract venue: its measured spend is that revenue line, placed on Events, and its options, equities, crypto and other lines are incumbent broker revenue, inside the incumbent pools (venue_spend.json: brokerage_lines_excluded)

Curve.cap: zero as placed, not observed: each tracked venue's measured spend is placed in full — Kalshi, Polymarket and Robinhood on Events, Hyperliquid on Price — and reconciles to its measured total (NOT-193), and none of the lines their measurements exclude — Polymarket's perps, Hyperliquid's HLP vault, Robinhood's brokerage lines — is term structure, carry or shape. No venue figure is placed on this board

hl.why: Hyperliquid's measured spend — core perps, HIP-3 builder DEXs and spot — is placed on Price; the funding its perps charge passes between traders and is no venue's revenue (no board counts the funding transfer: design/data/sources/curve-yield-carry-overlap.md), and its HLP vault is a Yield product

kalshi.why: Kalshi's measured spend is its whole DCM book of event contracts, placed on Events; none of it is term structure, carry or shape

pm.why: Polymarket's measured spend — its CLOB and combos — is placed on Events, and its perps, which that figure excludes, are Price instruments; none is term structure, carry or shape

rh.why: Robinhood is tracked as an event-contract venue: its measured spend is that revenue line, placed on Events, and its options, equities, crypto and other lines are incumbent broker revenue, inside the incumbent pools (venue_spend.json: brokerage_lines_excluded)

Engines.cap: zero as re-cut: this board carries the venue capture of the five pools' cells onto who pays and why; a cell carrying no venue figure is one the re-cut assigns none of it

Events.cap: zero as placed, not observed: each tracked venue's measured spend is placed in full — Kalshi, Polymarket and Robinhood on Events, Hyperliquid on Price — and reconciles to its measured total (NOT-193), Kalshi's and Polymarket's across this board's rows by each venue's own subject mix and Robinhood's on Kalshi's borrowed mix. A cell carrying no venue figure is one that placement gives none of it

hl.why: Hyperliquid's measured spend — core perps, HIP-3 builder DEXs and spot — is placed on Price; none of it is an event contract

one_line.rh: Robinhood's spend is one filed line, its event-contracts revenue, which books spread capture as revenue (venue_spend.json: spend_basis), so its fees and spread are not stated apart — an absence, not a zero

Frontier.cap: zero as classified: a cell carrying no venue figure is a subject and cadence at which neither Kalshi nor Polymarket traded in the window, by each venue's own first-party labels (semantic map)

hl.why: Hyperliquid trades position notional, not cash traded, and this board counts cash traded: it carries Hyperliquid nowhere rather than converting it (design/draft-frontier-board.py)

rh.why: Robinhood is a broker: its customers' contracts trade on KalshiEX — inside Kalshi's cash here — and on ForecastEx and Rothera, which this board does not measure
